fields.title: Live updates: video of plant fire spreads online

updates.label: CORRECTION
updates.text: An earlier update said the video showed a fire at the Halyard plant. The video was filmed in 2022 at another site, according to Lakeshore Fire Department.

updates.label: UPDATE
updates.text: A Halyard spokesperson said no fire was reported at the plant on Tuesday.

updates.label: NEW
updates.text: A video said to show a fire at the Halyard Components plant is spreading on social media. The Courier has not verified it.
